_doc: Shading lane round 2 painted override (rosace_shade.paint, WF-P12) for idle_hero at 144, over preset shading_r2k.json's automatic pass. Tones (deep / shadow / lit / hi) of the material named, masked to it and to the listed current tones, so the strokes follow any ramp change. Painted on the render in authored_on; STALE (skipped) if the canvas, anchor or pose change. Why: the automatic pass leaves the skin with no highlight at all (S1 0 px; ref 04's thighs carry a near-white shine) and the stockings as one flat dark mass (ref 08's have a lit ridge).

strokes.note: near thigh: highlight lens on the front plane, right of centre (the key side), 2-3 px wide, following the thigh's axis
far thigh: a shorter lens, the far form reads one step quieter
near stocking: sheen streak (I2) on the lit side under the knee band, 1 px, 4 px long, stepping with the leg's slant
far stocking: sheen streak on its lit (right) side
